0022600179.text: The Utah Jazz (1-6, 14th in the West, on a five-game losing streak) visit the New Orleans Pelicans (3-4, 11th in the West, on a three-game winning streak) in the eighth game of Utah's season. Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Trey Alexander (knee bruise) are out for Utah, and Mo Bamba (ankle) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while New Orleans is without Jordan Poole (ankle sprain) and Yves Missi (knee bruise), with Trey Murphy III (knee) also day-to-day and a game-time decision. Utah leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 120-119 win in Salt Lake City on October 23, and the Jazz lost all three meetings with New Orleans in 2025-26.
